WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.subcategory AS sub_aswas, cp.subcategory AS sub_asis, p.category cat_aswas
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT sub_asis, sub_aswas, cat_aswas, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) n_dist_line_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id)) receipts, sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM base WHERE sub_asis='Interior Paint' OR sub_aswas='Interior Paint' OR cat_aswas='ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL

SELECT 'returns_by_return_date' k, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) u
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_of_period_sales', count(*), sum(r.quantity_returned)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'skus_sold', count(DISTINCT cp.sku), sum(f.quantity)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  AND cs.store_id = 108
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY cs.store_id, cs.store_name
